summary:
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — Boolean properties can now be reliably toggled from the `k4run` command line: a dedicated parser was added that accepts `True/False`, `true/false`, `1/0` and rejects anything else, fixing cases where `--Prop False` was silently converted to `True` ([#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)). Support for the new `EventContext` data handle API introduced in Gaudi 41 was added and then hardened by requiring Gaudi v41r1 or later ([#432](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/432), [#436](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/436)). The `OverlayTiming` background particle index mapping was simplified from per-frame `std::map` lookups to direct indexing, which also fixed a silent-drop bug where daughter particles with empty parent lists were skipped, and delivered a measurable speedup ([#429](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/429)).
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — The IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detector was refactored and the FCC-SEED option was added across detectors (with new `CLD_o5_v01`), and ALLEGRO pixel pitches and Silicon Wrapper layer count were updated; requires downstream config updates ([#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612)). The ALLEGRO HCAL Endcap pseudo-layer position calculation used by PandoraPFA was corrected ([#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666)). The IDEA steering example was updated to set the workers event-sharing flag to `false` when running single-threaded ([#665](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/665)), and a bug in the XML→ROOT color caching path was fixed alongside a minor IDEA_o1_v01 XML tweak ([#667](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/667)).
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — `DCHdigi_v02` was renamed to `WireTrackerDigi_v01`, generalising the digitiser to work for both drift chambers and straw-tube trackers via a new `isSTT` Gaudi property that changes cellID field usage; the old name is still available via a backward-compatible alias ([#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100), [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/103)). A `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag was added to gate compilation of the FCCee tracking components, enabling builds in stacks without Marlin/LCIO (e.g. muon collider) ([#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/97)).
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — The local EDM4hep track conversion code was replaced with the upstream `ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil`; `ACTS2edm4hep_track` is now a thin wrapper around `writeTrack`, seed (`AtFirstHit`) and calorimeter (`AtCalorimeter`) track states are built with `writeTrackState`, and the track state covariance layout was fixed to follow `edm4hep::TrackParams` order so downstream consumers now read the correct elements ([#95](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/95)). A pass-through `ClassifiedEdgePrinting` stage was added to ease external validation of the GNN pipeline ([#105](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/105)).
- **[key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv](https://github.com/key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv)** — Obsolete EDM4hep version guards were removed from the conversion and comparison code, and the package now requires EDM4hep ≥ 1.0 ([#135](https://github.com/key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv/pull/135)).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Photon pointing information from Delphes is now propagated to EDM4hep: pointing angles are stored in `ITheta`/`IPhi` with `directionError`, and hit position uncertainties are stored via `positionError` for `errorPhi`/`errorTheta` ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)). Deprecated Delphes initialization/processing calls in the standalone and framework paths were replaced with current APIs ([#163](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/163)).
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — The EDM4hep file reader was made consistent with the HepMC3 reader: the vertex is now taken from the end vertex of the parent-less particle (defaulting to (0,0,0) when absent), enabling consistent results between the two intermediate layers between Pythia and `ddsim` ([#1684](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1684)).
- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter)** — A full seeded ECAL clustering chain for the IDEA o2 dual-readout calorimeter was added, comprising `CaloDrivenClusterSeeding`, `TrackDrivenClusterSeeding`, `ClusterSeedMerging`, `ClusterSeedGrower`, and a new `CreateOpticalCaloCells` that turns optical-photon SimCalorimeterHits into CalorimeterHits and links each cell to its truth energy deposit (with a `maskCherenkovForTruthLink` option); a CI test for the IDEA o2 reconstruction chain was also added ([#271](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/271)).
- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — ALLEGRO configurations gained TRAPPIST inference and π0 particle identification for both topoclusters and SW clusters in `o1_v03` and `o2_v01` ([#392](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/392)). ALLEGRO vertex and Silicon Wrapper resolutions were updated to 3 µm spatial / 5 ns timing and 50 µm/√12 respectively, following the recent baseline change ([#384](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/384)). The ALLEGRO_o2_v01 reconstruction now includes the STT digitiser and STT hits in track finding, with a fix to the perfect track fitter/finder wiring ([#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388), [#396](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/396)); ALLEGRO and IDEA scripts were also updated to follow the `DCHdigi_v02` → `WireTrackerDigi_v01` rename ([#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395)). IDEA Delphes/EDM4hep cards were added and ZH/ZZ/WW Pythia8 generator cards updated to winter2023 versions ([#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393)).
- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — Depth is now declared as a CLI argument rather than a config property, enabling full geometry conversion; remaining config properties were renamed and updated config files were shipped for ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA, and ILD_FCCee ([#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16)).
